empty.title: Nothing planned for this day
empty.text: There are no appointments or tasks for this day.
empty.textAction: Add an appointment or a task you have to do.

sheet.subtitle: An appointment or something you have to do
sheet.titlePlaceholder: What do you have to do?
sheet.hint: Time and notes are optional. Leave the time empty for a task you can do at any moment of the day.
sheet.rangeHint: One entry will be created for each day of the range, with no specific time, and you will be able to tick them independently.
sheet.rangeEditHint: This entry spans several days and is edited as a whole. Growing the range adds new days, and shrinking it deletes the ones left outside even if they were already done.
